user.title: Kamstrup meter
user.description: Select the serial device connected to your meter, or choose "Enter manually…" to type a path.

reconfigure.title: Change serial device
reconfigure.description: Select the new serial device for this meter, or choose "Enter manually…" to type a path.

error.port: Please select or enter a serial port.
error.cannot_connect: Can't connect to the given serial port.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The meter's serial device was updated successfully.

scan.title: Scan KMP registers
scan.description: Enter up to 32 registers as decimal or hexadecimal values, separated by commas. The scan runs once and is not saved.

error.invalid_registers: Enter 1 to 32 valid registers between 0 and 65535.
error.scan_failed: The register scan could not be completed.

scan_failed.title: Register scan failed
scan_failed.description: The meter could not be read.
